_comment: IdP token lifetime policy SSOT — Sprint S2-α. infra/keycloak/fcc-dev-realm.json's accessTokenLifespan / ssoSessionIdleTimeout / ssoSessionMaxLifespan MUST equal these values (enforced by tests/test_apps_web_auth_scaffold.py::TestIdpPolicySsotCrossCheck). Validated against idp-policy.schema.json (Sprint S2-β α-9). When tuning for prod IdP (Azure AD / Okta / Auth0) ship a separate idp-policy.production.json alongside the prod realm/tenant config — never edit this dev file with prod values.

_basisCitationRevision.ratchetTrigger: When BCP reaches RFC status, update _basisForValues citations to the assigned RFC number and remove this revision marker. TestExternalAuditRoadmapPresent verifies nextReviewDate has not lapsed.

_basisForValues.accessTokenLifespanSeconds: 600s (10 min) — OAuth 2.0 Security BCP draft-ietf-oauth-security-topics § 4.13 'short-lived access tokens'. NIST SP 800-63B § 4.2.2 suggests 30 min absolute for memorized secret reauth; we tighten to 10 min in dev so MIN_REFRESH_MARGIN_SECONDS (30s, RFC 6749 § 5.1) fires every ~9.5 min and exercises the silent-refresh path frequently.
_basisForValues.ssoSessionIdleSeconds: 1800s (30 min) — NIST SP 800-63B § 7.2 reauth-on-idle. Matches typical web app session timeout (Auth0 default 720m -> we shorten; Azure AD default 90d sliding -> we set explicit short ceiling for dev).
_basisForValues.ssoSessionMaxSeconds: 28800s (8h) — typical work shift ceiling. NIST SP 800-63B § 7.2 'reauthentication SHALL be performed at least every 12 hours' upper bound. Dev value lets a single-day lab session run without re-auth interruption.
